audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 5 read 'Skill' and row 6 reads 'Wukong', while the packet chart is Wukong on rows 0-5 and Vayne on row 6 — and whys[6], spikes[3].text and late all say two-plus items is Vayne's window.
audit.why: 50.1% over 1531 games with a losing early and a late flip; the chart disagreed with its own explanations on three rows.
audit.corrected: phases[3]/win[3] and phases[5]/win[5] set to Wukong, phases[6]/win[6] to Vayne, ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why called Blade of the Ruined King 'your spike — force fights' on a stage that is Wukong's, and phases[6].why gave a generic line instead of naming the actual two-item flip.
audit.why: whys[5] on the same page says his engage still out-trades an unfinished build, and the late flip is specifically true damage bypassing the armour Cyclone shreds.
audit.corrected: Both stage explanations rewritten to match the side each row now shows.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d (titled 'Wait for his W decoy') and dontsFull[1].d (titled 'Chase his clone') both carried duplicated generic text and never stated what the clone actually costs you.
audit.why: Silver Bolts needs three consecutive attacks against the same target, so autos spent on the decoy do not carry over to Wukong himself — that is the concrete reason chasing the clone loses the trade.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around the Silver Bolts consecutive-attack rule and holding Condemn until he reappears.
sources: ownerKit W text: 'third consecutive attack or ability against the same target'

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: His combo opens with the reset, so the wind-up — not the ability cast — is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Not written: with enemyKit null for this matchup I could not verify the reset against Riot's own text, only against the missing-interactions rule. Flagged rather than asserted.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers appear anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: enemyKit is null in the brief, so Wukong's per-rank cooldowns were not available and I will not guess them.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his: Nimbus Strike dashes onto you and Warrior Trickster's clone eats the Condemn you answer with. Farm at range and wait.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Nimbus Strike's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King alone does not beat his engage — wait for the second item before you duel him at all.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Wukong carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Silver Bolts' true damage ignores the armour Cyclone shreds, and Final Hour's Tumble invisibility answers his dive.

edits.before: Wukong wastes Nimbus Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: The clone eats Condemn — hold E until he reappears and commits.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Cyclone catches you inside its radius — break out sideways with Tumble, not back.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Autos on the decoy reset your Silver Bolts stacks on the real one.

notes: enemyKit is null in this brief, so no Wukong cooldowns, ranges or Riot ability text were available. Every edit here is grounded either in Vayne's own kit, the packet's ability-name list, or the page's internal contradictions — no Wukong mechanic is asserted that the brief did not already contain. The Crushing Blow auto-reset from missingInteractions was deliberately NOT written for the same reason.
